items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: He used to play in his sports brass band. The Allen band. Old man Allen.

ctx.x: When would he play drums? I mean, would he play drums on the same job while he was playing cornet?
Mm-hmm. He used to play in his sports brass band. The Allen band. Old man Allen. He had a good brass band.
Did Little Red play snare or bass? Who? The young one.
